structural_result.older_independent_parser: 0 problems, but 4 rows were treated as blank-marked exceptions because its hostname allowlist omitted codelibrary.amlegal.com, ayoobpeery.com and bernalhilldrywall.com; manual review confirms those rows do carry primary-source links

findings.finding: Heise's official Paint, Patch & Drywall Repair page expressly advertises plumbing-access drywall cutout repair, ceiling water-stain patching, paint touch-up, occupied rental/tenant-schedule coordination. This is stronger all-in-one service evidence than the current ranking narrative, which only says the drywall half must be subcontracted or separately contracted.
findings.proposed_action: Add a HEISE-DRYWALL official-company source; update Heise's ranking why/short_why/ask and F-18 to state the advertised restoration service while preserving the unresolved licensing/contract-structure gate. Do not infer B/C-9 self-performance from the service page.

findings.finding: The retrieved Watco 500/501/600TL sheet does not explicitly prescribe a fill/operate leak test. Step 7 says to remove/readjust the drop cylinder so the drain stops water when closed and says a slow drip from inside the tee is normal/acceptable.
findings.proposed_action: Remove the claim that the sheet includes a fill/operate leak test. Keep fill/function/leak testing before covering as a proposed acceptance control, supported by the manufacturer's adjustment/sealing instruction plus DBI inspection-before-covering, not as a verbatim manufacturer test step.
findings.status_after_pr52: partially resolved by PR #52: WATCO source and T-07 corrected; R-02/R-40 basis still attributes fill/operate testing to Watco

findings.finding: SF Plumbing Code §104.2 was retrieved in chunk 13; §104.5 was retrieved in chunk 14. Current source/flag wording attributes the exemption text to chunk 14 only.
findings.proposed_action: Correct the retrieval note to §104.2 chunk 13 and §104.5 chunk 14.

findings.finding: SF Plumbing Code §104.5 says replacement of a plumbing fixture or gas appliance without a change in drainage, piping or venting does not require payment of a permit issuance fee. This is a fee condition, not a permit exemption or a waiver of inspection/final-fee requirements.
findings.proposed_action: Add a separate compliance row with the exact conditional fee wording and a limitation that DBI must confirm applicability; do not subtract fees from any quote automatically.

findings.finding: BPC §7048(c) also excludes a person who advertises/holds out as a contractor or employs another person to perform/assist the work. Current C-07 mentions the under-$1,000/no-permit/larger-operation conditions but not these exclusions.
findings.proposed_action: Add the advertising/holding-out and employment exclusions to the rule/application/limitations.
findings.status_after_pr52: resolved by PR #52 in C-07/source support

findings.finding: BPC §7057(b) expressly says framing/carpentry cannot be counted in the two unrelated trades needed for a B prime/subcontract involving other trades. Current C-05 omits that exclusion.
findings.proposed_action: Add the framing/carpentry exclusion and preserve the requirement to name the licensed plumbing/restoration parties.
findings.status_after_pr52: partially resolved by PR #52: BPC-7057 source support includes framing/carpentry exclusion; C-05 rule text still omits it

findings.finding: R-03 is labelled an owner requirement, but the neutral owner record says photographs were not supplied; it does not state an owner requirement to obtain them.
findings.proposed_action: Change origin to Proposed control while keeping the photo-documentation acceptance check.

findings.finding: The at-least-three-identical-written-bids guidance is published by CSLB, but R-36 currently cites the owner record and CSLB contract page rather than CSLB's Finding the Right Contractor guidance.
findings.proposed_action: Add a CSLB-FINDING source and cite it for R-36; label the row as guidance/proposed control rather than an owner-supplied requirement unless the owner record is amended by the owner.

findings.finding: The canonical verifier's row-source check only requires any href="https://" in a row. It does not require a registered primary-source kind, and the older independent parser's hostname allowlist creates false blank-marked exceptions.
findings.proposed_action: Require every canonical tbody row to contain at least one HTTPS link whose URL resolves to a registered primary-source kind (official-government, official-company, official-manufacturer, official-code-publisher, official-tool, owner-record or repository-primary). Review-platform links alone must not satisfy the check. Add a regression test with a row containing only an unregistered HTTPS link.
findings.status_after_pr52: resolved by PR #52 verifier registered official-primary row check; regression coverage still worth confirming

findings.finding: Rapid Flow's official site advertises 844-BAY-FLOW while CSLB #1115649 lists (415) 866-8401. The current canonical phone is the CSLB number; the role distinction should remain explicit if a contact page is added.
findings.proposed_action: Preserve the CSLB phone as the registry-verified number; if adding the company call number, source it to the official contact page and flag the difference rather than silently replacing one with the other.
